Source-only regression fixtures; no native jobs have run.

`main.spl` invokes the actual production enum payload boundary with real parsed
parameter declarations and their production `lower_type` MIR types. Its missing
HIR expression/type provenance deliberately reaches the reviewed fallback. The
13 guards cover exact optional presence/inner carriers, same-owner imported alias
rows, nested arrays, Bool optionals, unrelated records, nonoptional records, same-name foreign owners, raw
integers and malformed presence slots. Alias IDs are allocated through the actual
SymbolTable and preserve exact defining-owner metadata; no foreign table IDs are
used. The fixture is compiler API diagnostic evidence, not a production admission.

`positive.spl` must compile, execute two assertions on nonempty/nil and empty
declared optional record arrays, and print its two-guard receipt. `wrong_record.spl` and `wrong_integer.spl` must be rejected with an
enum payload type mismatch; a compiled executable or unrelated compiler crash is
not a successful negative result. Root owns future bounded native execution.
